soc-net-01-c1.text: Georg Simmel (trans. and ed. Kurt H. Wolff) (1950). The Sociology of Georg Simmel. The Free Press (archive.org scan).
soc-net-01-c1.quote: for its life, it needs both, but for its death, only one.
soc-net-01-c1.claim: A dyad is fragile. If you're one half of it and the other person leaves, the relationship vanishes.

soc-net-01-c1.text: Georg Simmel (trans. and ed. Kurt H. Wolff) (1950). The Sociology of Georg Simmel. The Free Press (archive.org scan).
soc-net-01-c1.quote: that is, the third party which in some fashion or another draws advantage from the quarrel of two others.
soc-net-01-c1.claim: A triad can sustain coalitions, mediation, and the tertius gaudens ('the rejoicing third') who profits from the conflict of the other two.
